Frequently asked questions

How many Business Analyst jobs are open in the United States?

Fortune Jobs AI lists 191 open Business Analyst jobs in the United States as of November 24, 2026.

How much do Business Analyst jobs in the United States pay?

The 25th–75th percentile of listed salary midpoints is $73,300–$131,260 a year, based on 22 listings where employers list pay. Listings without usable pay data are excluded; hourly and yearly pay are not mixed.

Which employers are hiring for Business Analyst jobs in the United States?

Employers in this catalogue include GovCIO (56 listings), Capital One (28 listings), SitusAMC (27 listings), Cognizant (19 listings), and Turing (9 listings).

Is every listing fully remote from any state?

Check each listing; some remote jobs are limited to certain states or include location and worksite requirements. A remote label does not mean work from anywhere.
